fields.name: field_0
fields.evidence: Pointer to an object: bg3.exe creator bg3.exe+0x3011710 zeroes it; the bg3.exe load state machine (DoLoad, bg3.exe+0x2B4F280, state 5) sets byte +0x19 of the pointed object to 1 when loading finishes. Live: a heap pointer in all 6 samples.

fields.name: LevelData
fields.evidence: bg3.exe creator zeroes +8 (pointer), +0x10 (capacity/size), +0x14 (size) - the Array pattern. bg3.exe+0x2B4F8E0 (~ RootLevelSystem::Preload) appends 8-byte ls::LevelData* (array grow FUN_1405c4620 on +8, size +0x14); DoLoad state 1 waits until ls::LevelData::IsLoading is false for every element, state 5 releases them and sets the size to 0. Live: empty.

fields.name: field_18
fields.evidence: DoLoad state 2 passes &+0x18 as the third argument of the level load (bg3.exe+0x3C5A9C0 ~ ls::Level::Load(level, 1, FixedString const&)); bg3.exe+0x2B4FAB0 (~ RootLevelSystem::LoadLevel) copies it into a component of the new root-level entity (bg3.exe+0x412E090). Creator: -1 (null). Live: FixedString indices.

fields.name: LevelName
fields.evidence: DoLoad state 2: LevelManager GetOrCreateLevel(bg3.exe+0x3C14640, &+0x1C); state 3 broadcasts it (IncRef/DecRef); Preload looks the level data up by it; LoadLevel passes it to bg3.exe+0x3C14A90 (SetActiveLevel). Creator: -1. Live: FixedString indices (WLD_Main_A etc.).

fields.name: WaitFrames
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2B4FAB0 (LoadLevel) resets +0x20 to 0 while some entity is still busy and otherwise increments it; after more than 5 it proceeds. Creator 0; live 0.

fields.name: LevelCreated
fields.evidence: DoLoad state 2 sets +0x24 = 1 after the level loaded and local templates were added (Toolkit RootLevelSystem::CreateLevel does the same); state 5 checks it before releasing templates. Creator: 2-byte zero at +0x24.

fields.name: LoadFailed
fields.evidence: Set to 1 by DoLoad when a step fails (then state = 5) and by LoadLevel before activation, then = !activate(); state 5 calls the failure handler bg3.exe+0x3011600 when it is set; only when 0 the root-level entity is created.

fields.name: _Pad26
fields.evidence: Never initialised by the creator (live 0x00/0xFF/0x02 garbage): padding.

fields.name: State
fields.evidence: DoLoad switches on the dword at +0x28 (0 preload, 1 wait for level data, 2 create level, 3 broadcast, 4 load/activate, 5 finish) and advances it; creator 0; live 0.

fields.name: _Pad2C
fields.evidence: Never initialised by the creator (live 0x7FF4..., 0xFFFFFFFF garbage): padding to 0x30.
